definition: hydrogen predicted kg/h divided by renewable power AVAILABLE kW
units: kg per kWh available (proxy); inverse is kWh available per kg predicted, NOT SEC
evidence_required: documented boundary of available renewable power measurement (AC/DC, bus point, and losses)
simultaneous electrolyzer electrical input measurement or validated dispatch model
hydrogen actual production measurement, standardized mass basis and time matching
electrolyzer manufacturer operating limits, safety constraints, pressure, temperature, flow and current
source provenance and independent validation of predicted production
